findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: propmanagement_list_notifications · Private data: propmanagement_list_documents · Public sink: propmanagement_update_property, propmanagement_create_tenant, propmanagement_update_tenant.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: propmanagement_list_notifications · Private data: propmanagement_list_documents · Public sink: propmanagement_update_property, propmanagement_create_tenant, propmanagement_update_tenant

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
